meta.name: Migrate Salesforce accounts to GoHighLevel using Google Sheets

name: Bulk Import Salesforce Accounts to GoHighLevel as Business Records

parameters.content:
## 🏢 Salesforce to GoHighLevel – Bulk Business Account Migration with Contact Linking

### How it works
This workflow migrates Salesforce Account records into GoHighLevel as Business accounts. A manual trigger reads accounts from Google Sheets, applies a configurable batch limit, and loops through each row. For every account, it creates a GHL Business via the LeadConnector API and updates the corresponding custom object record with Salesforce-specific fields (SF account ID, parent account, price book, and owner). It then reads a contacts sheet to check whether any contacts are linked to that account — if so, it bulk-associates them to the new GHL Business. Every outcome is logged back to the relevant sheet tab: created, SF fields updated, contacts associated, no contacts found, or error. Progress is tracked row-by-row throughout the run.

### Setup steps
1. Replace `YOUR_GHL_API_TOKEN` in the Authorization header of all three HTTP nodes.
2. Replace `YOUR_GHL_LOCATION_ID` in the bulk associate request body.
3. Replace `YOUR_GHL_CUSTOM_OBJECT_SCHEMA_ID` in the Update Custom Object URL.
4. Connect **Google Sheets OAuth2** to all Sheets nodes. Update the `Salesforce Accounts Sheet` document ID and `GHL Contacts Sheet` document ID.
5. Confirm your sheet tabs match: `Accounts Tab` (main accounts), `Contacts Tab` (contacts list).
6. Adjust the `Limit` node to control batch size per run.
7. Run the manual trigger to start the migration.

## 📋 Account Batch Read & Loop
Reads Salesforce account rows from Google Sheets, limits to a configurable batch, and feeds them into the loop one at a time. The progress tracker updates the sheet row status at the start of each iteration.

nodes.name: Section – GHL Business Creation & Custom Object Update

parameters.content:
## 🏗️ GHL Business Creation & Custom Object Update
Creates a GHL Business via the LeadConnector API, then immediately updates the linked custom object record with Salesforce-specific fields. Both success and error outcomes are written back to the accounts sheet.

## 🔗 Contact Lookup & Bulk Association
Reads the contacts sheet to find any contacts linked to the current account. If contacts exist, bulk-associates them to the new GHL Business in one API call. Either way, status is logged and the loop advances to the next account.

## 🔑 Credentials & GHL IDs
- **GHL Private Integration Token** → `YOUR_GHL_API_TOKEN` (all 3 HTTP nodes)
- Replace `YOUR_GHL_LOCATION_ID` in the bulk associate body
- Replace `YOUR_GHL_CUSTOM_OBJECT_SCHEMA_ID` in the Update node URL
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** → accounts sheet + contacts sheet
